build: Release -O3 -DNDEBUG; coverage OFF; sanitizers OFF; Ninja -j4
method: 3 independent runs; 2 warmups and 7 measured batches per case/run; backend order rotates; normalized ns/op medians across 21 batches. Includes allocation, copy, destruction and identical full result checksum. Excludes input parsing.
limitations: Single CPU and Linux compiler; no Windows or non-x86 performance qualification
Scalar adapter may be autovectorized; unchanged upstream retains its existing optimizations
Coverage intentionally disabled for timing; separate prior SIMD qualification 74/75 lines,56/58 branches; new timing harness not coverage-measured
